notes: US 708: This is the only individually identified star analyzed as a target; it is a previously known hypervelocity star followed up here. The alias “HV2” at T:p11-b2 conflicts with “HVS2” at T:p2-b2 and is treated as a transcription/typographical error, so HVS2 is recorded and HV2 is omitted.

US 708: No explicit numerical right ascension, declination, distance, parallax, galactocentric radius, or bound/unbound probability is reported for US 708. The coordinate-like SDSS designation at T:p11-b2 was not converted into RA/Dec. The velocities 998 km/s (T:p8-b8) and 897 km/s (T:p10-b1 and T:p11-b16) are inferred ejection velocities relative to the progenitor binary, not Galactic-rest-frame speeds, so they are not assigned to galactic_rest_frame_velocity.
